paragraphs.text: Benjamin Franklin grew up in Boston. He is sometimes called Ben Franklin. He had a large family with sixteen brothers and sisters! As a child, he only went to school for two years. But he loved to learn, so he read books at home. Ben Franklin went to work for his older brother when he was just twelve years old. His brother ran a print shop. At the print shop, Ben Franklin made books and newspapers.

pieces.text: When Ben Franklin was seventeen, he moved to Philadelphia. He started his own print shop. He printed a newspaper. He also printed a book called
. In this book, Ben Franklin wrote about what the weather would be. He also wrote advice like "Time is money." This means that people should not waste time.

paragraphs.text: Ben Franklin did many things to help the city of Philadelphia. He helped start a library, a fire department, and a school! He was also in charge of Philadelphia's mail. He helped people send letters.

pieces.text: Ben Franklin came up with many new ideas. He used what he learned to help other people. He made a new kind of glasses that helped people see both nearby and far away. He also figured out that lightning is made of electricity. He made something called a lightning rod. A
is a metal stick on a roof. The rod catches lightning and stops it from hitting the house. This kept houses safe. Ben Franklin's ideas helped many people.

paragraphs.text: Paul Revere was born long ago in Boston. While he was growing up, Paul learned how to make things out of silver. He was very good at making pretty things like teapots and spoons. He also liked to draw pictures.
At that time, Boston was part of the Thirteen Colonies. The Thirteen Colonies belonged to a country called Great Britain. Paul Revere and many other people did not like Great Britain being in charge.
Great Britain sent soldiers to Boston. These soldiers made people follow Great Britain's rules. Paul Revere and other people did not like having soldiers in their city.

Sometimes, the soldiers and people from Boston got into fights. This made Paul Revere angry. He wanted other people to know what the soldiers were doing. So he drew a picture. His picture showed the soldiers hurting people. Many people saw his picture. They got mad at Great Britain, too.

paragraphs.text: George Washington was born in 1732. He lived in Virginia with his family. He had a big family, with nine brothers and sisters! They lived in a large house with lots of farmland.

Most children could not go to school at this time. They had to work or help their families at home. But Washington's father had a lot of money. So he paid for Washington to go to school with other rich children. Washington even had teachers who came to his home to teach him.

But when Washington was eleven, his father died. Now the family had less money. Soon, Washington could no longer go to school or have teachers come to him. So Washington never learned how to do things that other rich people could do, like speak French or play the piano.

But Washington had other skills. He was very brave, and he was good at leading other people. So he became a leader in the army. He fought in wars. Later, he even became the first president of the United States.

Most children could not go to school at this time. They had to work or help their families at home. But Washington's father had a lot of money. So he paid for Washington to go to school with other rich children. Washington even had teachers who came to his home to teach him.

But when Washington was eleven, his father died. Now the family had less money. Soon, Washington could no longer go to school or have teachers come to him. So Washington never learned how to do things that other rich people could do, like speak French or play the piano.

But Washington had other skills. He was very brave, and he was good at leading other people. So he became a leader in the army. He fought in wars. Later, he even became the first president of the United States.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Jefferson was born in Virginia in 1743. As a child, he loved to learn. He spent a lot of time reading and writing. He grew up to be a great writer.
When Thomas Jefferson was young, America was not a country. It belonged to another country called Great Britain. People in America had to follow Great Britain's rules.

pieces.text: Many people did not like that Great Britain was in charge of America. Thomas Jefferson was one of those people. So, he wrote the
. It said that Great Britain was not in charge of America anymore. America would be its own country, called the United States of America.
Thomas Jefferson wrote about many important ideas in the Declaration of Independence. He wrote that everyone should be equal and free. Being
means that everyone should be treated the same way. Being
means that people can make their own choices. When people are free, they can do what they want to do.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Jefferson was born in Virginia in 1743. As a child, he loved to learn. He spent a lot of time reading and writing. He grew up to be a great writer.
When Thomas Jefferson was young, America was not a country. It belonged to another country called Great Britain. People in America had to follow Great Britain's rules.

pieces.text: Many people did not like that Great Britain was in charge of America. Thomas Jefferson was one of those people. So, he wrote the
. It said that Great Britain was not in charge of America anymore. America would be its own country, called the United States of America.
Thomas Jefferson wrote about many important ideas in the Declaration of Independence. He wrote that everyone should be equal and free. Being
means that everyone should be treated the same way. Being
means that people can make their own choices. When people are free, they can do what they want to do.

pieces.text: Davy Crockett was born in Tennessee in 1786. Davy and his family were settlers.
were people who moved to a new place to start a new community. The place they moved to was called the

paragraphs.text: On the frontier, settlers lived far away from towns and cities. They had to do things for themselves. They cut down trees to build their homes. They hunted and grew their own food. Davy did not go to school very much. He farmed and hunted to help his family. Hunting on the frontier was not easy. Davy had to be strong and brave.

When the settlers came to the frontier, Native American people already lived there. The settlers wanted land from the Native Americans. So, Davy Crockett and other settlers fought a war against Native American people. The United States government helped the settlers win the war. Native American people lost a lot of land.

After the war, Davy Crockett got a job as a leader in Tennessee. Many people liked having him as a leader. He knew how hard it was to be a settler. He could help to make things better for them. Later, Davy Crockett got a job in the United States Congress. Congress makes laws for the country. Davy Crockett wanted to make laws that helped settlers on the frontier.

pieces.text: Davy Crockett was born in Tennessee in 1786. Davy and his family were settlers.
were people who moved to a new place to start a new community. The place they moved to was called the

paragraphs.text: On the frontier, settlers lived far away from towns and cities. They had to do things for themselves. They cut down trees to build their homes. They hunted and grew their own food. Davy did not go to school very much. He farmed and hunted to help his family. Hunting on the frontier was not easy. Davy had to be strong and brave.

When the settlers came to the frontier, Native American people already lived there. The settlers wanted land from the Native Americans. So, Davy Crockett and other settlers fought a war against Native American people. The United States government helped the settlers win the war. Native American people lost a lot of land.

After the war, Davy Crockett got a job as a leader in Tennessee. Many people liked having him as a leader. He knew how hard it was to be a settler. He could help to make things better for them. Later, Davy Crockett got a job in the United States Congress. Congress makes laws for the country. Davy Crockett wanted to make laws that helped settlers on the frontier.

contents.text: Why did Davy Crockett get a job in Congress?

choices.text: He wanted to write laws that were good for settlers.
He wanted to stop people from coming to Tennessee.
He wanted to send his children to school in the city.

paragraphs.text: John Deere was born long ago, in 1804. Back then, people did not have the machines that we have now, like computers and phones. But they did have metal tools, like hammers, nails, and shovels.

pieces.text: John Deere grew up in Vermont. When he was a young man, he became a blacksmith. A
makes tools out of metal. But there were already lots of blacksmiths where John Deere lived. So, it was hard for him to find work and make money.

John Deere moved to the Midwest to find work as a blacksmith. At that time, many farmers were moving there too. Farming in a new place was not easy. Farmers had to break up the dirt so their plants could grow. They used a tool called a plow to help. A
has metal blades that push through the dirt. But the dirt in the Midwest was too sticky. The plows got stuck in the ground and broke. Then John Deere helped the farmers fix their plows.

John Deere moved to the Midwest to find work as a blacksmith. At that time, many farmers were moving there too. Farming in a new place was not easy. Farmers had to break up the dirt so their plants could grow. They used a tool called a plow to help. A
has metal blades that push through the dirt. But the dirt in the Midwest was too sticky. The plows got stuck in the ground and broke. Then John Deere helped the farmers fix their plows.

makes tools out of metal. But there were already lots of blacksmiths where John Deere lived. So, it was hard for him to find work and make money.

John Deere moved to the Midwest to find work as a blacksmith. At that time, many farmers were moving there too. Farming in a new place was not easy. Farmers had to break up the dirt so their plants could grow. They used a tool called a plow to help. A
has metal blades that push through the dirt. But the dirt in the Midwest was too sticky. The plows got stuck in the ground and broke. Then John Deere helped the farmers fix their plows.

paragraphs.text: Abraham Lincoln was born in Kentucky in 1809. His family was poor. They lived in a log house with only one room. They worked hard on their farm. As a child, Lincoln planted seeds in the fields. He even cut logs with an ax.

Working on the farm kept Lincoln very busy. He did not have much time to go to school. But he loved to read. He kept a book in his pocket while he worked. Sometimes, he walked a long way to borrow books from his neighbors.

pieces.text: As Lincoln grew, he learned many things through books. He liked to learn about laws. So he decided to become a lawyer. A
is someone who can help people if they have a problem with the law. Later, Lincoln helped make laws in government. Finally, he became the 16th president of the United States.

paragraphs.text: Abraham Lincoln was born in Kentucky in 1809. His family was poor. They lived in a log house with only one room. They worked hard on their farm. As a child, Lincoln planted seeds in the fields. He even cut logs with an ax.

Working on the farm kept Lincoln very busy. He did not have much time to go to school. But he loved to read. He kept a book in his pocket while he worked. Sometimes, he walked a long way to borrow books from his neighbors.

pieces.text: As Lincoln grew, he learned many things through books. He liked to learn about laws. So he decided to become a lawyer. A
is someone who can help people if they have a problem with the law. Later, Lincoln helped make laws in government. Finally, he became the 16th president of the United States.

pieces.text: Frederick Douglass was born around 1818. When he was growing up, the United States allowed slavery.
means a person is owned by someone else and forced to work for them. Many Black people were enslaved. They had to work hard and did not get paid any money for their work.

paragraphs.text: Frederick was enslaved as a child. His life was hard. He lived on a farm in Maryland. Frederick had to work like an adult when he was young. He was often cold and hungry.

As a child, Frederick loved to learn. He wanted to know how to read and write. But enslaved people were not allowed to go to school. Frederick did not let that stop him from learning. Even though he had very little food, he gave some of it to white children so they would teach him. He also practiced with an old book. After Frederick learned to read and write, he taught other enslaved people, too.
When Frederick Douglass was 20, he ran away from the people who enslaved him. He went to New York City because slavery was not allowed there.

pieces.text: Frederick Douglass was born around 1818. When he was growing up, the United States allowed slavery.
means a person is owned by someone else and forced to work for them. Many Black people were enslaved. They had to work hard and did not get paid any money for their work.

paragraphs.text: Frederick was enslaved as a child. His life was hard. He lived on a farm in Maryland. Frederick had to work like an adult when he was young. He was often cold and hungry.

As a child, Frederick loved to learn. He wanted to know how to read and write. But enslaved people were not allowed to go to school. Frederick did not let that stop him from learning. Even though he had very little food, he gave some of it to white children so they would teach him. He also practiced with an old book. After Frederick learned to read and write, he taught other enslaved people, too.
When Frederick Douglass was 20, he ran away from the people who enslaved him. He went to New York City because slavery was not allowed there.

paragraphs.text: As a child, Harriet lived on a large farm. She had to work all day. She cooked and cleaned. She also did hard work outside. She farmed in fields and carried heavy logs.

Sometimes enslaved people were sold and taken away from their families. When she was young, three of Harriet's sisters were sold. They were taken far away. Harriet missed them. She did not want her family to be enslaved.

pieces.text: When Harriet Tubman was twenty-seven, she escaped. To

means to run away from the people who enslaved her. She was in the South, where slavery was allowed. But the North did not allow slavery. So, one night, Harriet followed a bright star called the North Star. It helped her find her way to freedom in the North.

content.text: Susan B. Anthony when she was 28 years old

paragraphs.text: Susan B. Anthony was born in 1820. When she was growing up, women were not treated the same as men. Women were not allowed to do things that men could do.

When Susan was little, she loved to learn. She read lots of books and worked hard in school. But many girls could not go to school. They had to stay home to help around the house. Susan did not think that was fair.

Susan B. Anthony grew up and became a teacher. At that time, men got paid more money than women. Men who were teachers got 10 dollars a month. But women only got 2 dollars. Susan B. Anthony thought that was wrong. She wanted women to be paid fairly.

pieces.text: Back then, only men could vote. When you
, you help pick a leader. Susan B. Anthony wanted more leaders who would treat women fairly. So, she worked to change the law so women could vote too.

When Susan was little, she loved to learn. She read lots of books and worked hard in school. But many girls could not go to school. They had to stay home to help around the house. Susan did not think that was fair.

Susan B. Anthony grew up and became a teacher. At that time, men got paid more money than women. Men who were teachers got 10 dollars a month. But women only got 2 dollars. Susan B. Anthony thought that was wrong. She wanted women to be paid fairly.

pieces.text: Back then, only men could vote. When you
, you help pick a leader. Susan B. Anthony wanted more leaders who would treat women fairly. So, she worked to change the law so women could vote too.

paragraphs.text: Amelia Earhart was born in 1897. Back then, airplanes were new. Flying was not as safe as it is today. Planes were not built very well. Sometimes planes would break and crash. And it was easy to get lost. Every flight was dangerous!

pieces.text: Even though flying could be scary, it was also exciting! When Amelia Earhart was 23 years old, she rode in a plane for the first time. She loved it! Amelia Earhart decided to become a pilot right away. A
is a person who flies airplanes.

paragraphs.text: Back then, most pilots were men. Many people did not think women could be pilots. But Amelia Earhart knew they were wrong. She wanted to show that women could be great pilots, too!

Amelia Earhart decided to fly across the Atlantic Ocean by herself. She flew for 15 hours. At the end of the flight, her plane leaked gas, and a fire started! She had to quickly land to put out the fire. But she had made it! Amelia Earhart was the first woman to fly a plane across the Atlantic Ocean alone.

content.text: Thurgood Marshall as a lawyer for the NAACP

pieces.text: Thurgood Marshall was born in 1908. Back then, many places were segregated.

means that Black people were kept apart from white people. Thurgood was Black. He was not allowed to go to the same school as white children. The schools for Black children were older and smaller than the schools for white children. They also had fewer books. Thurgood knew that this was not fair.

paragraphs.text: As a child, Thurgood spent time with his dad listening to lawyers talk in courtrooms. A lawyer is someone who understands the law. They can use the law to help people. Thurgood wanted to be a lawyer. He decided to go to law school. But most law schools did not allow Black students. So, Thurgood Marshall went to Howard University. It had a great law school for Black students.
Once Thurgood Marshall was a lawyer, he worked with a group called the NAACP. Thurgood Marshall and the NAACP helped Black people in court when they were being treated unfairly.

pieces.text: Thurgood Marshall was born in 1908. Back then, many places were segregated.

means that Black people were kept apart from white people. Thurgood was Black. He was not allowed to go to the same school as white children. The schools for Black children were older and smaller than the schools for white children. They also had fewer books. Thurgood knew that this was not fair.

paragraphs.text: As a child, Thurgood spent time with his dad listening to lawyers talk in courtrooms. A lawyer is someone who understands the law. They can use the law to help people. Thurgood wanted to be a lawyer. He decided to go to law school. But most law schools did not allow Black students. So, Thurgood Marshall went to Howard University. It had a great law school for Black students.
Once Thurgood Marshall was a lawyer, he worked with a group called the NAACP. Thurgood Marshall and the NAACP helped Black people in court when they were being treated unfairly.

contents.text: What is a segregated school?

choices.text: a school with both young and old children
a school where students with different skin colors all go
a school that is only for white children or only for Black children

pieces.text: Jackie Robinson was born in 1919. At that time, many places were segregated.
means that Black people were kept apart from white people. They could not go to the same schools or use the same bathrooms.
Growing up, Jackie Robinson was great at sports. When he went to college, he played many different sports. After college, Jackie Robinson became a baseball player. In
, people use a stick called a bat to hit a small ball.

paragraphs.text: Jackie loved to play baseball. But baseball was segregated. The most famous baseball teams were part of the Major League. Only white people could join the Major League. Black people had to play on their own teams. Their teams were not as famous. And Black players made less money.

One Major League Baseball team was called the Dodgers. The Dodgers had a boss who thought segregation was wrong. The boss asked Jackie Robinson to play for the Dodgers. Jackie agreed. When Jackie joined the team, it was no longer segregated. This showed people that Black and white players could be on the same team.

pieces.text: Neil Armstrong was born in 1930. When he was six, he rode in an airplane for the first time. He loved it! After this flight, he wanted to become a pilot. A
is a person who flies airplanes.

paragraphs.text: When Neil Armstrong was twenty-four years old, he got a job testing airplanes. He flew new planes and made sure they were safe. He tested more than 200 planes! Neil Armstrong became a great pilot.

pieces.text: Around the same time, people started to think about going to space.

is everything outside Earth, where the Moon and stars are. No one had ever been to space before! People began making the first spaceships. These spaceships had to be very strong and very fast. But this made them dangerous. Some spaceships even caught on fire!

The United States needed people to test the new spaceships. But no one had ever flown a spaceship before! People thought it would be like flying a plane. Neil Armstrong was great at flying planes. He was not afraid to try flying spaceships. So, the United States asked him to become one of the first astronauts. An
is a person who goes into space. Neil Armstrong was ready to help!

Today, many people have computers. People use them to learn, work, and have fun. But when Bill was young, computers were really big. Sometimes they were as big as a whole room! People did not have computers in their homes. Most schools did not even have computers. But Bill's school did! Bill spent a lot of time on the computer.

pieces.text: Bill learned about the parts that make up computers. The screen, the keyboard, and other parts that people can touch are called
. He also learned about the directions that tell a computer what to do. These directions are called

paragraphs.text: Bill learned how to write software. He could make computers do different things. For example, he wrote software so he could play tic-tac-toe on the computer. He started writing software to help people use computers at home, school, and work.

contents.text: Why did Bill Gates want to change computers?

choices.text: to make them easier to use
to make them cost more money
to make them bigger than houses

content.text: The passage says that Bill Gates learned how to write software. He could make computers do different things. He started writing software to help people use computers at home, school, and work. So, he wanted to make computers easier to use.
